None of these inspected sources provides the per-security actual institutional TWD required by V1. Source normalization, re-fetching or multiplying shares by close cannot supply that missing measurement.

Official Finnhub EPS/revenue model averages include provider proprietary estimates and inspected model fields do not establish revision vintage, currency or share-class measurement. A current retrieval cannot establish pre-announcement first-seen availability. Dedicated PIT products exist, but TW72 coverage, account entitlement, comparable accounting and reuse rights remain unverified.

The criterion-completeness distinction can be fixed without declaring mixed history intact or weakening selection thresholds. This synthetic reproduction does not establish the reason for the saved Production 72-stock snapshot.
